presets.name: Voice clarity
presets.note: A low cut at 80 Hz, less mud at 250 Hz, a little presence and air: a common first move on a spoken voice.

presets.name: Rumble cut
presets.note: A 24 dB per octave low cut at 80 Hz takes out traffic, handling noise and air conditioning.

presets.name: De-mud
presets.note: A low cut at 60 Hz and a broad 4 dB dip around 300 Hz clear a boxy or muddy sound.

presets.name: Presence lift
presets.note: 3 dB around 4 kHz helps a voice cut through music or effects.

presets.name: Air lift
presets.note: A gentle high shelf from 12 kHz for openness and sparkle.

presets.name: Telephone
presets.note: Steep cuts below 300 Hz and above 3.4 kHz with a lift at 1.5 kHz, like a phone line.

presets.name: Acoustic guitar
presets.note: Less boom at 200 Hz, a touch of string detail at 5 kHz and above.

presets.name: Bass weight
presets.note: Clears sub-rumble below 35 Hz, adds weight at 80 Hz and takes out a little 250 Hz mud.
